appraisal_events.evidence: À la grande surprise de Mme Verdurin, il ne lâcha jamais. Il allait les rejoindre n'importe où... plus souvent au théâtre, que Mme Verdurin aimait beaucoup.
appraisal_events.explanation: Swann proves surprisingly reliable and accommodating, consistently joining the Verdurins wherever they go and favoring the theater outings Mme Verdurin loves, exceeding her low expectation.

appraisal_events.evidence: Swann qui ne parlait jamais de ses relations brillantes, mais seulement de celles mal cotées qu'il eût jugé peu délicat de cacher, et au nombre desquelles il avait pris dans le faubourg Saint-Germain l'habitude de ranger les relations avec le monde officiel
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator reveals that Swann deliberately conceals his brilliant aristocratic connections while only mentioning his lesser ones out of tact, sharply elevating him relative to what the Verdurins perceive of his social standing.

status_effects.explanation: His unexpected reliability and eagerness to accommodate the clan reflect well on him, defying Mme Verdurin's low expectation.
His true social standing among the Faubourg Saint-Germain elite is revealed as far greater than what he lets on to the Verdurin circle.
